_comment: Deliberate cross-canonicals: pages that declare a <link rel="canonical"> naming a URL other
than the one they are served at. validate:seo fails on those by default, because that is how
15 pages shipped pointing at https://example.com/ and 12 more declared themselves duplicates
of their own hub. Sometimes it is the right call anyway (a print variant folding into its
screen page, a retired URL kept alive) — record it here rather than loosening the gate.
Per CLAUDE.md's 'Regression pins vs product decisions': a gate must not freeze an agent's
default as though it were a decision someone made. So each entry names the human who decided,
quotes what they said, and is held to the same standard as the tree — an entry whose finding
no longer fires FAILS and must be deleted, so this cannot become a file of stale absolutions.
Reasons shorter than 40 characters are rejected.
